description: Finds domains with observed transition signals; prioritizes leads. Supports yotpo, judge.me. Signals are correlational, based on fingerprint evidence. POSSIBLE_REPLACEMENT does not prove a switch. Observed coverage only; not full market view. Empty does not prove no transition. No live scan. Unsupported-vendor requests may persist demand telemetry. USE WHEN: prospecting leads. DO NOT USE WHEN: confirmed switch, current usage, domain detection/live scan, historical adoption/removal.

vendor.description: Vendor whose customer technology transition signals should be evaluated. Supported values: yotpo, judge.me.
vendor.title: Vendor

name: vendor_customer_transition_signal_lookup

actionable.description: Whether the transition signal is actionable for commercial delivery.

charged.description: Whether payment was settled for this chargeable CSI delivery; false for unsupported or non-chargeable outcomes.

error.description: Error type name on pipeline/discovery error, otherwise null.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the status, when applicable.

stale.description: Whether the CSI snapshot is stale and no longer actionable.

status.description: Machine-readable outcome status for the request.

supported.description: Whether the queried vendor is supported by this capability.
